اصطبحن (form VIII)
# اِصْطَبَحْنَ (iṣṭabaḥna) /isˤ.tˤa.baħ.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِصْطَبَحَ (iṣṭabaḥa)
# اُصْطُبِحْنَ (uṣṭubiḥna) /usˤ.tˤu.biħ.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِصْطَبَحَ (iṣṭabaḥa)
# اِصْطَبِحْنَ (iṣṭabiḥna) /isˤ.tˤa.biħ.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِصْطَبَحَ (iṣṭabaḥa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
